question.text: The electric field intensity is produced by the radiation coming from a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> bulb at a distance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math>. The electric field intensity produced by the radiation coming from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> at the same distance is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac></msqrt><mi>E</mi></math>. Where the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo></math>_________ .
